only_helper_semantic_change: Python3.9-compatible plain zip with explicit equal-length guard instead of zip(strict=True)
fixed_normalization: One numerical norm division before one right-to-left QR pass; positive diagonal convention; retain gauge scalar and reconstruction residual. Numeric defects are diagnostics, not certified zero.
fixed_unitary_completion: Two deterministic modified Gram-Schmidt passes; lexicographic standard-basis completion; one positive-diagonal QR. Fixed rank threshold1e-12. No rank adaptation or fallback.
basis_convention: Core(left,s,right) has s as most significant local bit; local wires are low bond bits followed by output. Output sites emitted most significant first.
growth: New scratch bit and new output start zero; incoming alpha occupies the first left_rank basis columns of dimension2*right_rank.
shrink: SWAP highest active bond bit into fresh output before the local unitary; exclude the newly zero scratch wire from the local decomposition. Final bond rank one implies all scratch is zero for the fresh-input preparation.
inverse: Literal reverse primitives with angle sign reversal; CX and SWAP self-inverse. Track global phases in both directions.
verification: Independent full dense native operator comparison for the one four-wire toy; entangled dirty-input literal inverse; fresh preparation scratch support check; independent contraction/site-order guards.
later_order: Freeze the q10 CDF and exactly three bond-native candidates
Only if some fixed target component ledger fits, freeze one synthesis registry
timing_exclusivity: Do not freeze or execute while Stage C timing jobs are active.
